claim_snippets.claim_text: The SDK uses an event-sourced state model with deterministic replay and a typed tool system with MCP integration.
OpenHands adds stuck detection for repeated same-action loops and redundant tool calls and can terminate execution automatically to prevent resource waste.
The agent is a stateless event processor whose design supports security interleaving, incremental one-step execution, pause/resume, recovery from context overflows, and event streaming.

OpenHands V1 makes agents, tools, and LLMs immutable and keeps a single conversation state object as the one mutable source of truth, enabling deterministic replay, strong consistency, and stable recovery.
